title: Consolidate and exercise the cross-repository collaboration package
problem: Entry repair #193 and receipt bootstrap #95 are unmerged separate drafts; declarations omit identity and overlap, consumer pointers are stale.
baseline: Existing pinned Discussion #89, issue #96, proposed #95 metadata v1 and draft #193 entry links; published Claude work shows duplicate compiler and colliding frozen evaluation paths.

alternatives.name: Pointer-only
alternatives.description: Keep only entry links and ordinary review.
advantages: Least maintenance and no CI burden
disadvantages: Does not flag stale revisions or incomplete handoffs mechanically
alternatives.revival_evidence: Pilot process overhead exceeds rework saved.

alternatives.name: Central transactional task service
alternatives.description: Mandatory atomic leases and server-side authoritative task scheduler.
advantages: Can serialize competing writes in enrolled clients
disadvantages: New availability and authentication infrastructure; does not cover clients outside service; overlaps product runtime responsibilities
alternatives.revival_evidence: Measured claim races persist after acknowledged splits and justify a separate authorized design.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Continue current drafts and manual founder reconstruction.
disadvantages: Confirmed discoverability and duplicate-work failure remains

roles.position: Complete the real entry-to-handoff loop; preserve Body + Organs + Mind.
material_concerns: Do not redefine complete as files created.

roles.position: Reuse #95 validator and #193 routing as one versioned package.
material_concerns: Do not install a second runtime or synchronization authority.

roles.position: Require session, scope, overlap disposition and acknowledgment declarations.
material_concerns: Metadata remains forgeable; branch protection and real review remain distinct.

roles.position: One guide, short client pointers, existing consumer PRs, bounded five-PR pilot.
material_concerns: Stale branches and excessive ceremony can cause more rework.

roles.position: Retain first failures, unavailable sources and unacknowledged ownership.
material_concerns: Never label model rehearsal as external Claude adoption.

evidence.claim: Prior metadata checker passes 24 tests but lacks worker identity and overlap fields.
evidence.reference: Independent protocol_review session, exact #95 inline workflow and tests
evidence.finding: 24 tests passed; stale AGENTS revision and nonexistent review links accepted; see VALIDATION.md.

counterevidence.reference: Prior duplicate compiler #165/#170 and #155/#158 evaluation collisions
counterevidence.finding: Rejected: published work and metadata acceptance do not establish exclusive claims, comprehension or independent review.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Discover the same intended outcome and existing work; implement non-overlapping packages; transfer exact source/evidence without founder reconstruction.

advantages.statement: Single reusable guide and metadata validator.
advantages.amplified_value: Consistent boot and handoff across repositories without duplicating runtime governance.

disadvantages.statement: A central guide can drift or become unreachable.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Pin consumers to immutable revisions; preserve Discussion and board as routing, not copied policy.

disadvantages.statement: Claim notices can race, lie or hide semantic duplication.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require scoped session declarations, inspected references and explicit split acknowledgment; pause overlapping edits and require human/peer review.

disadvantages.statement: Old rollout branches can overwrite newer instructions.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Build updated trees from current defaults, preserve old branch ancestry and current file suffixes; compare final diffs.

disadvantages.statement: New receipt obligations can create bureaucracy and a fragile mandatory check.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Reuse one metadata-only workflow, no new lock service; stage with optional checks, five-PR measurement and pointer-only rollback.

disadvantages.statement: Fresh model exercises can be misrepresented as live Claude coordination.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Label rehearsal separately and retain external-client acceptance as unverified until actual sessions acknowledge.

comparisons.baseline: Fragmented drafts: low adoption and repeated context reconstruction.
comparisons.do_nothing: No cost but leaves known failures.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Pointer-only is cheapest and remains rollback if measured burden exceeds benefit.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Atomic central task service can improve exclusion but adds availability, credential and authority cost; not justified by this install.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Consolidate existing package, upgrade receipt, stage pins, run independent review and fresh-session sandbox exercises; measure five completed PRs.

rejected_alternatives.name: Central transactional task service
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Creates another service and apparent lock authority without enrolling all clients.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Measured collisions after explicit acknowledgment plus an authorized ownership/design decision.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack centralization, forged acknowledgments, stale pins, legacy instructions, adoption claims and ceremony. Five perspectives are parent self-review; separate test/code reviewer evidence is identified independently.

new_weaknesses.statement: A session can fabricate acknowledgment references or edit its own workflow.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Label check metadata only; verify references and trusted workflow at integration; do not treat green as permission.

new_weaknesses.statement: Pinned consumer workflow remains a dependency on the kernel source commit.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Retain immutable source; adopt kernel before consumers; repin through reviewed PR; no hidden network fetch from agent hooks.

new_weaknesses.statement: Two prior drafts and a growing guide confuse current versus historical instructions.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: One current START_HERE with six SOPs; historical #95 referenced only for provenance; short entry pointers; explicit rollout table.

No new runtime locks, scheduler or product trunk. Exactly two strengthening passes for this new rollout decision, linked to the prior entry decision.

residual_risks.risk: Unenrolled clients ignore instructions; existing Claude conversations and local edits remain invisible.
residual_risks.mitigation: Explicit actual-client boot/claim/handoff acknowledgment; no global success claim.

residual_risks.risk: Metadata and review references can be false or stale.
residual_risks.mitigation: Receiver checks exact heads and actual source/evidence; protections remain independent.

dissent.handling: Five named perspectives are self-review, not five independent reviewers. Adversarial objection is retained; independent scoped review and rehearsals are recorded in VALIDATION.md, never converted into authorization.

entries.position: Do not call this enforcement or complete adoption from green metadata checks.
entries.rationale: No atomic lock, authenticated acknowledgment or external client visibility.
entries.evidence_threshold: Actual enrolled sessions demonstrate collision split and receiver resume on adopted revisions.

authority_impact.approver: Alfonso Lopez: Complete it and improve it. Comprehensively; authorizes preparation and reversible implementation, not unrelated live effects or bypass of merge/access gates.

migration_plan: Stage consolidated kernel #193; retain #95 history and designate it provenance; refresh four existing consumer drafts preserving current default instructions, add remaining scoped fork pointers; review before adoption; publish prepared Discussion addendum when authenticated; enroll existing sessions and measure pilot.

steps: Remove only newly required status rule before removing any workflow.
Close unadopted drafts or revert scoped adopted pointers/workflow; preserve negative evidence and decision records.
Use pointer-only guide if receipt overhead exceeds observed benefit; preserve current runtime, history and authority controls.

kill_criteria: Any loss of current repository instructions or evidence.
Any implication that a coordination claim grants execution authority.
Five completed PRs show more process cost than rework prevented.
review_trigger: Before adoption, first real-client collision/handoff, and five completed coordinated PRs
